The mention outcome update does not exist (no column, entity or service), so nothing can be confirmed as successful. recommendation: Not claimable as built. Only the generic PLUS success reply format (owned by suspensions) is Sebagian; the mention outcome update does not exist.

steps.step: OCMS updates the mention outcome on the notice for a PLUS request that meets the conditions
steps.detail: There is no mention outcome update: no column, entity, service or endpoint stores it. Tried synonyms mention outcome, dnata, adjourn/adjournment, withdraw/withdrawal, discharge, hearing, postpone, acquit across all six repos (java, ts/tsx, properties, sql; ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi) in both UI and API layers. Only relevant hits: the UI message at useStagePermissions.tsx:86 telling the officer to 'apply DNATA' with no DNATA function behind it; the type Icourtmention.d.ts:1-33 (field mention_outcome) is TypeScript only and unused; /v1/courtmention is in api-authorization.properties:23 but there is no courtmention controller/entity in ocmsadminapi and the UI never calls it.

steps.step: OCMS sends a success message to PLUS so the PLUS user knows the update succeeded
steps.detail: A success reply to PLUS exists on another PLUS endpoint: plus-apply-suspension returns per-notice results with appCode OCMS-2000 (SuspensionProcessingController.java:552-555; envelope at SuspensionProcessingController.java:1109-1110). That is a generic suspension mechanism; no mention-outcome path uses it. Sebagian at most, consistent with OCMS25.4.
